latestVersion.changelog:
AI Video Maker Gratis initial release — create and export free videos from your images and clips.

- Upload MP4, MOV, JPG, PNG files up to 500MB for cloud-based 1080p MP4 video creation.
- Easily combine photos, logos, clips, background music, and text overlays via chat prompts.
- Designed for small business owners and social media creators — no paid software needed.
- Includes guided session management, auto token creation for free credits, and real-time status updates.
- Supports checking credits, timeline state, and exporting/download of finished videos.
- All processing done on fast cloud GPUs; typical jobs take 1–2 minutes.
